summary: Retail store manager with 15 years of experience running large teams and multi-million-pound budgets. Ready for an operations management role in the West Midlands.

Store of the Year for the Midlands region, 2023

experience.title: Deputy Store Manager
duties: Managed deliveries, stockroom and a team of 12
Covered the store manager's role during absences

experience.title: Department Supervisor
duties: Supervised the fresh food department and its team of eight
